description: This file defines request handlers for web login operations, including starting and waiting for login via QR code, utilizing external plugin and protocol modules.

methods.name: resolveAccountId
methods.description: Extracts the accountId string from parameters if present.

methods.name: respondProviderUnavailable
methods.description: Responds with an error indicating the web login provider is unavailable.

methods.name: respondProviderUnsupported
methods.description: Responds with an error indicating the web login provider does not support the requested operation.
